# Command Prompts - commands 

    ###### serve the ollma ##########

        # start backend server for ollama 
         $ ollama serve


    # Check ollama version 
        $ ollama --version

    
    # Download a model 
        $ ollama pull qwen3.5:2b
        $ ollama pull llama3.2:1b

    # Delete Model 
        $ ollama rm <model_name>

    # List Available Models 
        $ ollama list

    # Run model directly in cmd
        $ ollama run <model_name>
        $ ollama run llama3.2:1b

    # Check model details 
        $ ollama show <model_name>


################### Using Python #################
    requests library = for calling BE communication/API
    $ python -m pip install requests

    https://github.com/ollama/ollama/blob/main/docs/api.md?utm_source=chatgpt.com
    

## How to find specific model for specific domain? 
    search : medical benchmark dataset used for LLM training. Then search dataset name in Ollama
